rules.accepted_credit_types: AVMA, its constituent organizations and recognized specialty groups; AVMA COE/CVTEA-accredited institutions; AAVSB RACE; USDA APHIS accreditation modules (1 h each, capped); Board meetings (capped); other Board-approved programs
rules.new_licensee_rule: Waived for a new licensee completing the initial term who graduated within 12 months of initial licensure.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; CE applies to one renewal cycle only.
rules.alternatives: Fellowship, internship or residency may be approved in lieu of CE; waivers/extensions for disability, illness, military duty.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit at least 10% of licensees; keep documentation 4 years.
rules.notes: Annual; CE period Oct 1 - Sept 30. Max 3 h practice management/wellbeing; min 3 h live; max 3 h pre-recorded online. At least 1 h in pharmacy/controlled substances, antimicrobials, or laws (licensee's choice).
